answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation on an identity graph: every agent account is a vertex whose edges record real resource expenditure, and rewards flow only along edges that carry verified work rather than raw account counts. New identities start in an umber zone of limited trust and must earn violet-tier attestation from diverse, established peers through repeated successful transactions. Because each attestation costs the attester reputation if the newcomer defects, colluding rings find fake identities unprofitable while honest single agents accumulate weight naturally.
